post.quote: Be where your feet are. Your team can tell when you're somewhere else.
post.practice: For one meeting, close the laptop and stay fully in the conversation. Notice what you hear.
post.question: Where is your mind when others are talking?

caption:
Attention is the rarest gift a leader gives.

“Be where your feet are. Your team can tell when you're somewhere else.”

Try this today: For one meeting, close the laptop and stay fully in the conversation. Notice what you hear.

Where is your mind when others are talking? Tell me in the comments.

Save this for your next 1:1 and send it to a leader you respect.
